name: YAxisPhysicsCharacter3D
description: A port of GDevelop's built-in 3D physics character controller that uses Y as the up/gravity axis and walks on X/Z.
shortDescription: Y-up 3D physics character behavior for Jolt/Physics3D.
author: Christopher Monhollen

eventsBasedBehaviors.name: YAxisPhysicsCharacter3D
eventsBasedBehaviors.description: Control a 3D physics object as a Jolt character using Y as the up/gravity axis. This is based on GDevelop's built-in 3D physics character behavior.

eventsFunctions.name: SimulateForwardKey
eventsFunctions.description: Simulate a press of the move forward key.

eventsFunctions.name: SimulateBackwardKey
eventsFunctions.description: Simulate a press of the move backward key.

eventsFunctions.name: SimulateLeftKey
eventsFunctions.description: Simulate a press of the move left key.

eventsFunctions.name: SimulateRightKey
eventsFunctions.description: Simulate a press of the move right key.

eventsFunctions.name: SimulateJumpKey

eventsFunctions.name: SimulateStick
eventsFunctions.sentence: Simulate stick for _PARAM0_ _PARAM1_ with angle _PARAM2_ and force _PARAM3_
eventsFunctions.description: Simulate analog movement input. The input is consumed by the 3D physics step hook.

eventsFunctions.name: StepCharacterNow
eventsFunctions.description: Immediately run the Y-axis character update. Usually not needed because the controller is hooked into the Physics3D step.

eventsFunctions.name: AbortJump

propertyDescriptors.name: FallingSpeedMax
propertyDescriptors.label: Max. Falling Speed
propertyDescriptors.description: Maximum falling speed along the Y axis.

propertyDescriptors.name: Gravity
propertyDescriptors.label: Gravity
propertyDescriptors.description: Y-axis gravity acceleration. Negative values fall downward in GDevelop Y-down scenes; positive values are also accepted.

propertyDescriptors.name: JumpHeight
propertyDescriptors.label: Jump Height
propertyDescriptors.description: Approximate jump height in pixels along the Y axis.

propertyDescriptors.name: JumpSustainTime
propertyDescriptors.label: Jump Sustain Time
propertyDescriptors.description: Maximum time in seconds during which jump strength is sustained if the jump key is held, allowing variable-height jumps.

propertyDescriptors.name: ForwardAcceleration
propertyDescriptors.label: Forward Acceleration
propertyDescriptors.description: Forward acceleration on the X/Z walking plane.

propertyDescriptors.name: ForwardDeceleration
propertyDescriptors.label: Forward Deceleration
propertyDescriptors.description: Forward deceleration on the X/Z walking plane.

propertyDescriptors.name: ForwardSpeedMax
propertyDescriptors.label: Max. Forward Speed
propertyDescriptors.description: Maximum forward/backward speed on the X/Z walking plane.

propertyDescriptors.name: CanBePushed
propertyDescriptors.label: Can Be Pushed By Other Characters
propertyDescriptors.description: Allow external physics velocity to influence the character, useful when characters or moving bodies push it.

propertyDescriptors.name: ShouldBindObjectAndForwardAngle
propertyDescriptors.label: Keep Object Angle And Forward Direction The Same
propertyDescriptors.description: Read the forward angle from the object rotation every frame.

propertyDescriptors.name: SidewaysAcceleration
propertyDescriptors.label: Sideways Acceleration
propertyDescriptors.description: Sideways acceleration on the X/Z walking plane.

propertyDescriptors.name: SidewaysDeceleration
propertyDescriptors.label: Sideways Deceleration
propertyDescriptors.description: Sideways deceleration on the X/Z walking plane.

propertyDescriptors.name: SidewaysSpeedMax
propertyDescriptors.label: Max. Sideways Speed
propertyDescriptors.description: Maximum sideways speed on the X/Z walking plane.

propertyDescriptors.name: SlopeMaxAngle
propertyDescriptors.label: Slope Max. Angle
propertyDescriptors.description: Maximum slope angle in degrees, measured against the negative Y up axis.

propertyDescriptors.name: StairHeightMax
propertyDescriptors.label: Max. Stair Height
propertyDescriptors.description: Maximum stair height in pixels, applied along the negative Y up axis.

propertyDescriptors.name: DeactivateConsoleLogging
propertyDescriptors.label: Deactivate Console Logging
propertyDescriptors.description: If enabled, disables the diagnostic console logs for this behavior.
